text:
jordana: FYI ACME (private) reports their Console graphs for tenant acme-123 dropped to zero starting ~2026-03-12T09:12Z. API calls return 200 and responses look fine, but requests_count and latency_p95 are empty. They mentioned an auth-proxy tweak around 09:10 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern?

akg: can you share a minimal curl (redact tokens) and the request headers the customer sent?

jordana: here's the curl they provided:
```
curl -H "authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
     -H "X-Customer-ID: acme-123" \
     -H "X-Org-Token: tok_REDACTED" \
     https://private-acme.example.com/v1/complete
```
Response body OK, but telemetry shows nothing for acme-123. They also run an envoy sidecar in front of our proxy.

michael: infra deployed a proxy normalization at 09:10 that rewrites headers. It looks like it renamed `X-Customer-ID` -> `X-Org-Handle`. Our metrics pipeline keys on `X-TENANT-ID` (numeric tenant id) from the incoming headers. If the header gets renamed and we don't map it, ingestion will index under `tenant:unknown`.

monitoring-bot: ALERT: metrics-ingest-rate low on private-cluster-2 between 2026-03-12T09:11:00Z and 2026-03-12T09:25:00Z (ingest 0.06x baseline)

dan: checking traces for that window: traces include tags `org_name` and `org_token`, but the keying map step expects `tenant_id` numeric. There's a missing mapping from external identifiers to internal tenant ids in the ingestion transform.

akg: quick mitigation plan: add a fallback in ingestion that tries `X-Customer-ID`, `X-Org-Handle`, and `org_token` -> internal `tenant_id` if the numeric header is missing. We can enable it as a hotfix and reflow buffered metrics. Low-risk temporary shim.

michael: agreed. Pushing shim to ingestion now. Will notify when enabled.

michael: hotfix deployed at 2026-03-12T09:27:45Z — ingestion fallback enabled and backfill kicked off.

monitoring-bot: METRIC: metrics-ingest-rate recovered for private-cluster-2 at 2026-03-12T09:31:50Z

jordana: ACME CSM confirms Console graphs show traffic again from ~09:34Z. They saw about a 22 minute gap. Customer happy with mitigation but asked for root cause and POA.

michael: root cause summary: proxy header standardization renamed external header keys without coordinating the downstream ingestion mapping. Ingestion expects a numeric `X-TENANT-ID` header; rename caused keying failures and metrics to be attributed to `unknown`, filtering them out of the org-level dashboards.

michael: action items:
- revert header rewrite or preserve original header (preserve aliasing) in proxy config — owner: michael — ETA 2026-03-12T18:00Z
- add end-to-end integration tests for header aliasing and resolver mapping — owner: dan — ETA 2026-03-20
- update private-deploy runbook to call out header contract and release checklist — owner: michael — ETA 2026-03-15
- keep ingestion fallback enabled for 72h to cover any stragglers, then remove once tests pass — owner: akg

acme-support: customer notified; wants written postmortem and tests before final proxy change. They appreciate the quick restore.

jordana: filing a ticket and scheduling a short postmortem with eng-infra + eng-platform. Marking customer-facing incident as resolved. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
